plugins.description: Beon Media's editing system for videos in DaVinci Resolve: house rules with a mandatory job card, Footage Prep first, footage sort, A-roll cutting, B-roll rulebook, QA manager agent on every stage, colour grading, per-client subtitles (Fluid Reveal Words), finishing, always-on learning approved by the editor running the job; standard intake for Beon editors and freelancers.
